<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><B>ASSET BACKED FACILITY</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><B>&nbsp;</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0; text-align: justify">On July 10, 2026, Nebius Compute II,
LLC, a Delaware limited liability company (the &ldquo;US Borrower&rdquo;), and Nebius Compute II Oy, a Finnish limited liability company
(the &ldquo;Finnish Borrower&rdquo;; together with the US Borrower, the &ldquo;Borrowers&rdquo;), each an indirect wholly owned subsidiary
of Nebius Group N.V. (the &ldquo;Company&rdquo;), entered into a Senior Facility Agreement (the &ldquo;Facility Agreement&rdquo;) with
(i) MUFG Bank, Ltd., London Branch, as mandated lead arranger, underwriter, sole bookrunner and structuring agent, and as agent on behalf
of the financial institutions party thereto (the &ldquo;Lenders&rdquo;), and the Security Agent (as defined below) (in such capacity,
the &ldquo;Agent&rdquo;), (ii) the Lenders and (iii) Kroll Trustee Services Limited, as security trustee for the Lenders (in such capacity,
the &ldquo;Security Agent&rdquo;). The Facility Agreement provides for a senior secured term loan facility in an aggregate principal amount
of approximately $775 million. The Facility Agreement was entered into primarily to finance the buildout of the Company&rsquo;s AI cloud.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0; text-align: justify">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0; text-align: justify">Amounts borrowed under the Facility
Agreement are subject to an interest rate per annum equal to Term SOFR (with a floor of 0.00%) plus an applicable margin of 2.50% per
annum for a one-month interest period. The Borrowers may voluntarily prepay outstanding loans under the Facility Agreement upon ten business
days&rsquo; prior notice to the Agent without premium or penalty, other than customary &ldquo;breakage&rdquo; costs. The maturity date
of the Facility Agreement is October 31, 2030.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0; text-align: justify">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0; text-align: justify">The Borrowers are required to comply
with certain financial covenants under the Facility Agreement, including a debt service coverage ratio of 1.15:1.00 and a minimum liquidity
requirement. The Facility Agreement contains other affirmative and negative covenants and customary events of default.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0; text-align: justify">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0; text-align: justify">All obligations under the Facility
Agreement are secured, subject to certain exceptions, by substantially all of each Borrower&rsquo;s assets, and the shares of the Borrowers
held indirectly by the Company.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0; text-align: justify">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; margin-left: 0; text-align: justify">Subject to certain exceptions, the Company has
provided (i) a non-recourse guaranty for specified &ldquo;bad acts&rdquo; of the Borrowers and (ii) a performance guarantee of certain
obligations of Nebius B.V., Dutch private limited liability company and wholly owned subsidiary of the Company (in its capacity as manager),
under a management agreement, and Nebius DC Oy, a Finnish limited liability company and indirect wholly owned subsidiary of the Company,
under a data center colocation agreement.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">A press release announcing the signing of the
Facility Agreement is attached as Exhibit 99.1.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>
